messages:
maria: Quick sync: starting a 2-week svcacct entitlement scrub focused on KMS bindings — we have ~120 svcaccts with broad key access. Need volunteers for RBAC exports, audit-log linkage, canary removal plan, and rollout notes. Target finish: Fri 2026-05-01. Volunteers?

jon: I can take RBAC exports + run rbac-exporter to get bindings. Will drop artifacts to /eng-sec/entitlement/svcacct-exports.

casey: I'll do audit log linkage — need help mapping key resource names to principal emails. What's the preferred query surface (Stackdriver -> Splunk pipeline)?

akshay: I can own the canary removal plan + runbook. Suggest canary window 48h and tag all changes with `entitlement-scrub-SEC-482`. Also recommend an automatic fallback policy (re-apply binding) if we observe >5 errors/min.

sec-bot: SEC-482 created by maria: Entitlement scrub - svcacct KMS binding cleanup. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-482

maria: Thanks. Jon, please run: ```rbac-exporter --project=redwood-prod --out=svcacct-rbac.json``` then: ```jq -r '.bindings[] | select(.role | contains("cloudkms"))' svcacct-rbac.json > kms-bindings.json``` Post results to the exports dir and ping here.

jon: :thumbsup: will run this tonight and share the file. Any preferred redaction rules?

casey: Redact key material yes. Keep key resource names (projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*) — we need those to map audit logs. Remove principal emails older than 90d unless flagged by owners.

akshay: For canary: pick 5 low-traffic svcaccts, remove `roles/cloudkms.admin` -> replace with least-priv role + monitor errors for 48h. If errors spike, revert via terraform automation (we have that in infra).

maria: Also need to ensure KMS audit logs are retained in Splunk for 90d. Casey, confirm retention. If not, open an infra ticket.

casey: Checked: current retention 30d in Splunk. I'll open INFRA-914 to increase to 90d and cross-index to sec-watchlist.

jon: Uploaded `svcacct-rbac-1719009876.json` to /eng-sec/entitlement/svcacct-exports. Will add a short manifest with suspected over-perms.

maria: Nice. Akshay can you draft the canary runbook snippet? Example command to remove binding: ```gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member='serviceAccount:svc-foo@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.admin'``` Add smoke tests after change.

akshay: Will draft. Also propose automated smoke checks: attempt `kms:decrypt` on a test blob and monitor deny/5xx counts. If we see >5 denies in 5m, trigger rollback.

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: /remind @eng-security in 21 days to run retrospective and close SEC-482.
